en.headline: Police arrest 36-year-old over disputed Mark Six jackpot among FEHD staff
en.dek: A health inspector is detained on suspicion of theft after colleagues alleged he refused to share a half first-division prize of more than HK$30 million from last Saturday’s draw.
body: Police arrested a 36-year-old man on Friday evening on suspicion of theft in connection with a dispute over a Mark Six jackpot shared among Food and Environmental Hygiene Department staff.

According to police, a man reported on Wednesday that he and several colleagues had pooled money to buy tickets for the 5 September draw, with one male colleague handling the purchase. After the tickets won, the parties could not agree on how to divide about HK$30 million in prize money.

Sources said 15 staff members of the department’s Market Revitalisation Section had contributed and that a half first-division unit, together with secondary prizes, produced a total payout of roughly HK$33 million. The 36-year-old, understood to be a health inspector, received the funds into his account and later declined an equal split.

Western District Crime Unit Team 5 has taken over the case. The arrested man is being detained for inquiry. The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said it was aware of the police investigation and would cooperate as required.

zh.headline: 食環署職員夾份中六合彩逾三千萬 警拘36歲男子涉盜竊
zh.dek: 據報15名街市活化組人員合資中半注頭獎，負責買票的衞生督察疑拒平分後被拘捕，現正扣留調查。
body: 警方周五晚上拘捕一名36歲男子，涉嫌盜竊，案件與食環署職員夾份中六合彩彩金糾紛有關。
警方表示，周三接獲一名男子報案，指上周六與數名同事合資購買彩票，由其中一名男同事負責落注。中獎後雙方未能就約3,000萬元彩金分配達成共識。
消息指，食環署街市活化組15名職員夾份投注，中得半注頭獎連同其他獎項，總獎金約3,300萬元。負責購買的36歲衞生督察將彩金存入個人戶口後，疑拒絕按原定協議平分，並曾請假未上班。
案件交由西區警區刑事調查隊第五隊跟進，被捕男子現正被扣留調查。食環署回覆指知悉警方正調查，會按需要配合，現階段不宜評論。
